2608.14172.title: Concept Guidance: Precise, Training-Free Latent Control for Text-to-Image Generation
2608.14172.paper_summary: Text-to-image diffusion models have two major drawbacks that severely limit their practical utility: (1) standard models lack an intrinsic mechanism for continuous, concept-specific guidance (e.g., for precisely controlling how aesthetically pleasing an image looks), and (2) they lack reliability for tasks requiring high local coherence (e.g., generating text or human hands). To tackle these issues, we introduce a novel notion of concept-wise mutual information and find large, concept-dependent differences between individual layers, demonstrating that the generation of specific structures is localized in distinct parts of the network. We exploit this insight by reinforcing the impact of concept-relevant layers in Concept Guidance (CoG), a precise, target-specific guidance method that works for models out-of-the-box without additional training, external models, gradients, or prompt engineering. CoG first quantifies each layer's concept-specific impact and then guides denoising using a weighted combination of predictions generated with concept-relevant layers skipped. We demonstrate performance increases across various targets and popular models like PixArt-alpha, SD3, SD3.5, and FLUX.1-dev. Code is available at https://github.com/CompVis/concept_guidance
2608.14172.paper_summary_zh: 文本到圖像的擴散模型有兩個主要缺點，嚴重限制了它們的實際效用：(1) 標準模型缺乏一個內在機制來實現連續的、特定概念的指導（例如，精確控制圖像的美觀程度），以及 (2) 它們在需要高局部一致性的任務中缺乏可靠性（例如，生成文本或人類手部）。為了解決這些問題，我們引入了一種新的概念互信息的概念，並發現個別層之間存在較大的、依賴於概念的差異，證明特定結構的生成是局部化在網絡的不同部分。我們利用這一見解，通過在概念指導（CoG）中加強與概念相關的層的影響，這是一種精確的、針對特定目標的指導方法，適用於無需額外訓練、外部模型、梯度或提示工程的模型。CoG 首先量化每層的概念特定影響，然後使用跳過與概念相關的層生成的預測的加權組合來指導去噪。我們在各種目標和流行模型（如 PixArt-alpha、SD3、SD3.5 和 FLUX.1-dev）中展示了性能的提升。代碼可在 https://github.com/CompVis/concept_guidance 獲得。
